text:
chris: quick heads-up — trying to finalize catalog entries for verdant3b and lark-4b before Thursday launch window. need ✅ on licensing + perf profiles. any blockers?
anya: tagging legal and infra. on licensing: verdant3b has CC-BY-4.0 for weights but model card flags dataset excerpts — legal will confirm reuse terms.
legal-bot: @anya hi — I ran a quick check, flagged 'dataset excerpt' clause for review. can someone paste the specific model card paragraph?
vikram: pasted below from model-card.md:
```
Training data: mixture of web-scrapes, curated news, some proprietary corpora. small excerpts from X dataset used under fair-use.
```
vikram: my read: not a straight permissive statement. legal probably needs to confirm risk tolerance for hosted vs private.
sophia: perf summary from bench: verdant3b median p99 latency 78ms on A100-40GB baseline, token throughput ~2900 tok/s. lark-4b is much cheaper but slightly higher latency on long context. putting numbers into the catalog page now.
jen: quick infra note — KV cache not behaving for lark-4b with our current tokenizer shim; we saw token id mismatches in canary, opened CR #4127.
chris: @jen @vikram OK — CR #4127 needs to be prioritized before canary traffic. what's ETA?
jen: assigning to @ron, estimated fix by EOD tomorrow if no blocker.
ron: looking now, root cause is padding token offset in tokenizer config. small change, need one integration test run.
anya: legal request: if licensing uncertain, mark model as 'catalog: restricted-preview' and do not enable hosted tier — only private or dedicated until cleared.
chris: agreed. we'll gate hosted for verdant3b until legal thumbs up. can we still do a dedicated canary?
mlinfra-bot: note: dedicated canary requires capacity reservation 2x baseline for 48h. submit reservation ticket via infra self-serve.
vikram: I'll submit reservation ticket and attach perf artifacts.
sophia: also adding a prompt set for quality checks — 120 prompts, edge-case tokenization included. putting into /s3/catalog-evals/verdant3b/sha=ef23
chris: action items recap: 1) @ron fix CR #4127 (tokenizer) by EOD tomorrow. 2) @anya legal to advise on 'dataset excerpt' clause; if unresolved, mark restricted-preview. 3) @vikram submit dedicated reservation + attach perf logs. 4) @sophia finish eval set + upload. 5) @jen run integration tests once tokenizer change deployed.
anya: I'll update catalog metadata to reflect restricted-preview until legal sign-off.
ron: starting on the PR now, will ping when tests pass.
jen: will schedule a short smoke test run after deploy — ETA 2 hours after PR merge.
chris: thanks all. if legal clears tomorrow morning we flip hosted on a soft canary (5% traffic) and watch latency/cost metrics 24h. otherwise stick to dedicated-only rollout. :thumbsup:
vikram: quick Q — do we need to bump quantization profile for verdant3b? sophia, any signal from perf runs?
sophia: yes — 4-bit q8f1 caused slight degradation on QA prompts. recommend q4f3 for now. I'll note in catalog under 'recommended quantization'.
anya: legal: pinging — can you confirm timeline?
legal-bot: legal ack: we'll have a short memo by tomorrow 11:00 PST with recommended gating language.
chris: perfect. I'll schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow at 11:30 to decide final gating. thanks everyone. :calendar:
